name: Terrain Chunk Voxel Generation
definition: A method to populate a voxel chunk with solid voxels based on procedural heightmaps, handling both surface terrain (y >= 0) and subsurface layers (y < 0).
summary: Terrain Chunk Voxel Generation populates a 3D voxel grid using a 2D Perlin noise heightmap, uniquely handling both surface terrain and subsurface layers in a single pass.
